description: Replaces the text of one Notion comment. Notion's API edits only comments created through the same connection, and answers not found for any other. Returns the comment.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

comment_id.description: The comment's id, from notion_get_comments or notion_create_comment.

text.description: The new text, as plain text. Over 2,000 characters is split into several text pieces.

name: notion-mcp__notion_update_comment
